name: Spiritual Agony, Greater
body:
School enchantment [pain]; Level cleric/oracle 6, inquisitor 6, lathspell 4, shaman 6, sorcerer/wizard 6, witch 6

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as lesser spiritual agony except the damage is increased to 1d6 nonlethal per caster level (maximum 20d6) and the target is nauseated for 1 round per level, then sickened for 10 minutes thereafter. A successful save halves the damage and reduces the effect to sickened for 10 minutes.
